planned_by: Claude (Critic): T35 decisions are lost on redeploy
goal:
T37 — store harness adoption decisions (T35) durably so they survive API redeploys.

services/api/evoforge/decisions.py keeps decisions in a process list; every deploy erases the adoption history that
/performance shows. Store each decision in the existing evidence store used for measurements and certificates
(main._evidence = postgres_state.ScopedRecords("records"), memory or PostgreSQL) as a record with kind
"harness_decision" and the full decision document; list_decisions() reads them back from that store (newest first by
created_at, at most 50) instead of process memory. Keep the record()/list_decisions()/clear() API and the
GET /v1/eval/decisions response shape. Avoid an import cycle with main.py (e.g. decisions.py takes the store lazily via
postgres_state.ScopedRecords("records")). Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t37.py. Do not change sealed_eval.py.
